title: SDLC Local Config
description: Validates .sdlc-v2/local.json — user-local (gitignored) configuration for sdlc skills.

reviewSection.description: User-local defaults for the review skill.

scope.description: Which changes to include in the review.

planStyleSection.description: User-local narrative preferences for the plan skill.

verbosity.description: How much prose /plan writes in narrative sections.

audience.description: Assumed reader background for plan narrative sections.

narrativeRules.description: Free-form writing rules /plan enforces on narrative sections.

receivedReviewSection.description: User-local defaults for the received-review skill.

alwaysFixSeverities.description: Severities whose 'will fix' findings bypass the per-finding consent gate. Local-only — must NEVER be set in .sdlc-v2/config.json.

steps.description: Pipeline steps to run. Replaces legacy preset/skip fields.

quick.description: Optional shortened step list activated by --quick. When set, /ship --quick uses this list instead of steps[]. Unset means --quick is not available for this project. See R-quick-1.

bump.description: Version bump level. Accepts `major|minor|patch` or any pre-release label matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9]*$` (e.g., `rc`, `beta`, `alpha`). Label values are forwarded to pr_apply as releaseLevel:"patch" plus releasePreRelease:<label>.

draft.description: Open the pull request as a draft.

reviewThreshold.description: Minimum severity level that blocks the pipeline.

rebase.description: Whether to rebase before shipping, or prompt the user.

verifyPipelineTimeout.description: Maximum seconds verify-pipeline polls before giving up with a warning. (R57)

verifyPipelineMaxIterations.description: Maximum analyze-fix-recheck iterations before verify-pipeline emits a warning and proceeds. (R47, R57)

awaitRemoteReviewTimeout.description: Maximum seconds await-remote-review polls before giving up with a warning. (R57)

awaitRemoteReviewers.description: Logins (case-insensitive) whose reviews satisfy await-remote-review. When the login is `copilot`, the reviewer must also be a Bot. (R56, R57)

executeWaveTimeout.description: Maximum seconds a single execute wave may run before stalled tasks are terminated. Forwarded to execute-plan as `--wave-timeout`. The maximum restates MaxWaveTimeoutSeconds in internal/shipmeta/fields.go, which is the single enforcement point (Monitor.timeout_ms caps at 3600000 ms). (R57, R-WAVE-DEADLINE)

executeWaveInterval.description: Seconds between execute wave liveness poll attempts. Forwarded to execute-plan as `--wave-interval`. (R57, R-WAVE-LIVENESS)

automationSection.description: Controls per-step pipeline automation, the review-fix loop, plan-drift halting thresholds, and the end-of-run execution report.

mode.description: Default automation mode for steps not listed in steps{}. "supervised" requires confirmation; "unattended" runs automatically.

reviewFixSeverityThreshold.description: Minimum review-finding severity that triggers a fix attempt.

steps.description: Per-step automation mode overrides, keyed by step name.

drift.description: Rate-based thresholds for halting an unattended run on plan drift (KD-3). The effective threshold is max(minErrorFloor, ceil(rate * totalTasks)).

maxErrorRate.description: Fraction of total tasks that may error before the run halts.

maxWarningRate.description: Fraction of total tasks that may warn before the run halts.

minErrorFloor.description: Minimum absolute error count tolerated regardless of maxErrorRate, so small plans aren't held to an unreachable fractional threshold.

report.description: Controls the execution report emitted at the end of a run (KD-11).

enabled.description: Whether to emit an execution report.

push.description: Controls whether a feature-branch git push during ship is auto-approved without a manual confirmation pause (KD-1). Default-branch (main/master) push is never auto-approved regardless of this setting — ship_prepare hard-gates it server-side.

featureBranchAutoApprove.description: When true, a feature-branch push skips the manual confirmation pause. Forced true at runtime when automation.mode is "unattended", even if explicitly set to false here.

workspaceSection.description: User-local workspace preferences. Workspace itself is auto-detected (branch/continue) — this section only carries branch-name derivation knobs consumed by lib/branch-name.js. The former worktree-placement and mode keys are removed (workspace is no longer user-selectable; fixes #378, #379).

branch.description: Branch-name derivation knobs consumed by lib/branch-name.js. Mirrors workspace.worktree shape. Drives config-driven branch naming in both ship pre-execute block and execute-plan standalone Step 1 (fixes #378, #379).

template.description: Branch name template. Supported placeholders: {type} (mapped via typeMap), {slug} (truncated to slugMaxLength), {issue} (optional ticket key, empty string when not provided), {date} (YYYYMMDD in local tz). Unknown placeholders throw.

slugMaxLength.description: Maximum length of the slug segment before substitution into the template.

typeMap.description: Maps logical plan type to branch prefix. Merged with defaults: {feature:'feat', bugfix:'fix', chore:'chore', docs:'docs', refactor:'refactor'}. Override specific keys to customise prefixes.

version.description: Schema version of this local config file. Current version is 2; v1 files (no version field, with ship.preset/ship.skip) are auto-migrated on read.
